jobs.role: Software Engineering Intern — Intern Hiring Challenge 2026
jobs.expYears: Student / early-career internship; check challenge eligibility
jobs.desc: Cepheid Intern Hiring Challenge 2026 is an online, employment-linked assessment for a Software Engineering Intern opportunity associated with the Cepheid team at Danaher India Development Center, Bengaluru. The official challenge window is 27 November–6 December 2026 (6:00 PM–11:59 PM IST each day). The challenge lasts 2 hours 15 minutes and requires a webcam. The official public page identifies this as a job opportunity and shows registrations; signing in to HackerEarth may be needed to register or participate.
jobs.elig: Independent listings report 2026/2027 graduating batches pursuing B.E. in Computer Science or Artificial Intelligence. Java and Angular knowledge is expected. The public HackerEarth overview does not display these academic conditions without login; verify the official challenge instructions before registering.
resp: Register/sign in to HackerEarth and check the official eligibility and instructions.
Complete the 2-hour-15-minute online hiring challenge during its November 27–December 6 window.
Prepare for 10 Angular multiple-choice questions and one Data Structures & Algorithms coding question in Java (as described in recent challenge summaries).
Use a desktop or laptop with a working webcam and follow the proctoring instructions.
jobs.workMode: Online assessment; internship based in Bengaluru
jobs.sourceVerificationMethod: Exact official public HackerEarth challenge page read on 5 Nov 2026: upcoming Nov 27–Dec 6 dates, job opportunity designation, 4.2K registrations, online duration and webcam requirement displayed. Registration workflow itself requires sign-in and was not completed. Academic criteria/assessment pattern supported by contemporaneous secondary sources only.
jobs.who: 2026 or 2027 B.E. Computer Science / Artificial Intelligence students with Java, Angular and DSA skills who meet the exact HackerEarth challenge eligibility after login.
